			hidden_effect = {
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_rechtsstaat = -10 } }
				hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_rechtsstaat min = 0 max = 100 } }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_protest_up_6
			hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = protest_strength } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { protest_strength = 0 } } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { protest_strength = 6 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = protest_strength min = 0 max = 100 } } }
			add_stability = -0.02

			custom_effect_tooltip = cwfo_tt_head_welt

			every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDIP.550 days = 1 } }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 modifier = { factor = 0 is_ai = yes } }
	}
